verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI agent platform like Decagon, but the evidence pack never documents user-defined recurring schedules or cron-style workflows. Proactive agents that initiate calls 'at the right moments' describe one-off, trigger-based outreach rather than a recurring schedule. Watchtower's continuous review of interactions is an adjacent monitoring feature, not job scheduling, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
